build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a multi-ramp teeter-totter physics puzzle scene with parameterized dimensions
create_cos_helper: create a helper function that computes the cosine of an angle given in degrees
add_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable angle, scale, and position
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene that can roll across ramps and teeter-totters
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define the goal relationship between the ball and target body
